description: Two ill-fitting stones share a charcoal loop while an unnecessary pebble rests outside.

checks.demo: Four real metadata roots reduced to requests ==2.25.1 and idna >=3.10; two removal witnesses verified.

visual_review.method: Viewed the complete final PNG and decoded JPEG; compared ancestor pixels; counted the two unchanged hands.
visual_review.ancestor_pepe_and_marks: Preserved pixel-for-pixel outside the new pictograph masks, which do not intersect old paint.
limitations: Visual review is subjective, not independent certification.
Fine rock texture inside the small composited mark masks can differ; every pixel outside the masks is unchanged.
The 512-pixel JPEG makes individual finger details less distinct.

tool_limitations: Finite numeric version subset, not full PEP 440 or an installer.
Irreducible roots are not necessarily a minimum-cardinality conflict or a repair.
Core audit reruns the inherited solver; it is not an independent unsatisfiability proof checker.
Examples omit interpreter/platform constraints and extras. No security or installability claim.
A budget-limited reduction or audit may remain inconclusive.
output_delivery: wall-v3.png is an untracked required output; no generated output was force-added to Git.
